mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECIPE r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.AUTHOR_ID = m.MEMBER_ID

SELECT r.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, r.AUTHOR_ID AS memberId, r.TITLE AS title, 0 AS viewCount, r.SOURCE_TYPE AS sourceType, r.STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(r.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt, m.NAME AS userName, m.LOGIN_ID AS loginId FROM RECIPE r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.AUTHOR_ID = m.MEMBER_ID
ORDER BY r.RECIPE_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT r.RECIPE_ID AS recipeId, r.AUTHOR_ID AS memberId, r.SOURCE_TYPE AS sourceType, r.TITLE AS title, r.SUMMARY AS summary, r.THUMBNAIL_URL AS thumbnailUrl, r.COOK_MINUTES AS cookMinutes, r.DIFFICULTY AS difficulty, r.SERVINGS AS servings, r.STATUS AS status, TO_CHAR(r.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, m.NAME AS userName, m.LOGIN_ID AS loginId FROM RECIPE r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.AUTHOR_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId}
